description: Synthetic Keelcard data. expected_counts.records is the two household cards in fixture (a), and expected_counts.assets is 0. The other sources describe the freelancer, delegate and December partitions. Fixture (a): 62 approved, 1 decline, 14 statements. Fixture (b): 508 approved, 37 declines, 22 statements, from 2025-01 through 2026-11. Fixture (c): 0 authorizations, 1 open change request. December 2026 is 48 staged events applied after env.advance_time.

sources.description: Fixture (a), household seed fixtures/minimal.json. 2 cards, 62 approved authorizations, 1 decline, 14 statements, 62 distinct dates from 2025-09-20 to 2026-11-14. Weekly card card-4417 has 61 approved and 1 decline on 61 Saturdays.
Fixture (b), fixtures/freelancer.json. 6 cards, 60 merchants, 508 approved authorizations, 37 declines, 22 statements, 397 distinct dates from 2025-01-01 to 2026-11-11.
Fixture (c), fixtures/delegate.json. 0 authorizations, 0 declines, 0 statements, 1 open owner-approval change request on 2026-11-18.

Staged scenario events in examples/events/freelancer-2026-12.json. 48 events: 24 authorization.request, 23 authorization.capture, 1 ledger.settle_due. 23 approved, 1 decline, 18 distinct dates in 2026-12. Applied after env.advance_time. Never pre-session history.

transformations: Normalized timestamps and account IDs. The package seed remains fixture (a). Fixture (b) history is generated from 2025-01 through 2026-11. December 2026 is a separate staged event file.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism, variation and reuse permissions. Partition counts are in the source descriptions. Coverage is contribution/coverage.md.
